title: Add destination_v11: the speed curriculum with more rehearsal and a back-off
summary: Two surrogate destination_v10 runs from v9 reached 0.1 m/s with every 0.05 to 0.1 m/s walk within a millimetre of the ghost, then let the destination pay fall from 0.73 to 0.42 at 0.125 m/s, which cost the 0.05 m/s walks their millimetre end gaps. destination_v11 keeps v10 but sends three quarters of the walks at the slower levels and lowers the top speed one step whenever a full window falls below 0.65.
next: Train destination_v11 from the v9 checkpoint on the surrogate and test it against v9 at 0.05 to 0.15 m/s.
